Numerical tests are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A single bridge-monitoring observation is a minimal natural information budget for barrier detection in stochastic numerical simulation. The sharp phase threshold at one quarter of the interval, leading constants and unique fixed-time large-deviation-rate optimum characterize two genuinely different rare-barrier information mechanisms and quantify how monitoring location affects Bayes information. The result does not claim generic algorithmic superiority, moving-time or finite-barrier optimality.
